html:
shared/scripts/build/generate-sitemap.js

Emits the whole crawl surface under website/public/meta/:
Source src/shared/scripts/build/generate-sitemap.js
UX surface The repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

URLSET_XMLNS

XML namespaces emitted on every .

escXml

Escapes text for XML element bodies (media titles/descriptions).

titleOf

Truncates a media title to Google's 100-char video-title bound.

mediaItemsOf

Media items of a project — mirrors website/views/project/modal.ts's traversal exactly: sections → groups (arrays whose head is NOT a string — string-head groups are text blocks) → media objects. Every object with a src is a real asset on the page and gets indexed; items with a label additionally get their own /portfolio/<slug>/<media> deep-link URL.

mediaRowsOf

Labelled-media deep links of a project — slug → media item. Distinct captions can collapse to the same slug, so occurrences after the first gain -2, -3, … in document order — byte-identical to mediaSlugSeq in core/utils/string.ts so every item keeps an indexable URL and the emitted pages + runtime resolver agree.

mediaTagXml

XML media tags for one media item — image:image or video:video.

projectPageTags

Aggregated media tags for a project page — cover + every item, deduped by resolved asset URL.

sitemapDoc

Emits one <urlset> document for urls, media tags included.

localeUrlsOf

URLs owned by one locale — /<loc> plus its localized routes, portfolio deep links and star-field bodies.

localizedLlms

Localized llms.txt — swaps the intro line for the locale's about text.

localizedCatalog

Localized ai-catalog — entry URLs get the / prefix (docs stay EN).
